newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gunmen kill four in S.Africa's Zulu region.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill four in S.Africa's Zulu region.

text.p: Gunmen killed four people in attacks on two homes in South Africa's troubled KwaZulu-Natal region, police said on Saturday.
Six men armed with AK-47 assault rifles and pistols shot dead a 62-year-old woman in her Umgababa home 40 kilometres (25 miles) south of Durban on Friday night, said a police spokesman.
"The men then went to another house nearby and shot dead three men aged between 23 and 26," Director Bala Naidoo said.
There wqqs no known motive for the attacks in the region riven by years of violence between the ruling African National Congress and the Zulu Inkatha movement.
Police reinforcements have been sent to the area, Naidoo added.
